contract_limit.statement: The official schedule dataset contains scheduled timepoint stops rather than complete stop inventories; omitted non-timepoint stops cannot prove a negative.
contract_limit.consequence: timepoint_stops_added and timepoint_stops_removed cannot be treated as exhaustive stop sets.

supportable_positive_parts: Q15 predecessor correspondence has 15 exact shared timepoint-shape pairs and can support a bounded Q15 lineage decision after risk review.
unsupported_required_parts: The dossier has no before-Q61 service row.
Q34 has zero exact shared shape pairs and status no_exact_shared_timepoint_stop_id.
The new-service remainder cannot be partitioned into exact Q15, Q34, and Beechhurst/Linden Hill portions from the current identifiers.
exemplars.safe_current_outcome: Keep Q34 lineage and any unpartitioned remainder unresolved or receipt-terminal; do not infer shared stop ids.

supportable_positive_parts: The AM-peak frequency member can receive a structured period/direction grain decision after risk review.
unsupported_required_parts: The broad stop-removal member requires an exhaustive exact stop set.
The dossier reports only scheduled timepoint changes and therefore omits non-timepoint removed stops.
exemplars.safe_current_outcome: Keep the stop-removal extent unresolved or receipt-terminal until an authoritative historical full-stop inventory with stop ids is acquired.

supportable_positive_parts: X64-to-QM64 correspondence has 34 exact shared timepoint-shape pairs.
The Elmont extension boundary and AM-peak service scope can support risk-reviewed bounded/grain decisions.
unsupported_required_parts: The broad stop-removal member cannot be closed from a timepoint-only diff.
The Midtown stop-addition member names more stops than the timepoint dataset enumerates, so the dossier is not an exhaustive stop set.
exemplars.safe_current_outcome: Keep non-exhaustive stop members unresolved or receipt-terminal; do not promote a partial timepoint set as the complete treatment extent.

replace_required_outcomes: Q61: require positive bounded/lineage decisions only for predecessor portions with exact shared identifiers; permit receipt-terminal Q34 and unpartitioned remainder rows until an authoritative equivalence or full-stop source is acquired.

QM44: require the structured AM-peak service-scope decision; permit the stop-removal member to remain unresolved in the v1 companion with a receipt-terminal ledger verdict until historical full-stop ids are acquired.

QM64: require the bounded Elmont extension and structured AM-peak service-scope decisions; permit non-exhaustive added/removed stop members to remain unresolved in the v1 companion with receipt-terminal ledger verdicts.

Replace the three exemplar all-positive DONE criterion with a supportability matrix: every member must be either positive with exhaustive exact evidence or unresolved with an immutable, candidate-specific, receipt-backed terminal verdict.

If exact Q34 lineage and removed-stop ids remain mandatory before Plan 041, add a bounded acquisition prerequisite for authoritative historical full-stop inventories and stop-id equivalence records; Plan 041 must not infer them from timepoint schedules or map prose.
unchanged_rules: No occurrence, study, or route-treatment cross-product authorization.
No prose-only service scope or lineage.
No partial timepoint set promoted as an exhaustive stop_set.
